answer: Cross-chain identity binding at the reef: 1 identity = 1 address provably active on 3+ chains, verified by light-client proofs. A ripple in one chain's state forces re-attestation of all. Cost to fake n identities: n × gas × 3 chains, roughly 12x single-chain. Attacker cap hits the tundra fast: at 50 identities, $4,800 locked versus $400 revenue. Works because forgery cost scales superlinearly while payout stays flat.
